name: Automation implementation - unsupported page or action
messageRegex: .*Error: (Page|Button|Section|Field|Option|Dropdown|.* button|.* field).* (is not recognized|is not supported|is not supported for).*

name: Authentication state preparation
messageRegex: .*(Timed out waiting for authentication state lock|Unable to determine the source feature|Credentials are missing for).*

name: Browser lifecycle closed prematurely
messageRegex: .*Target page, context or browser has been closed.*

name: Locator or UI synchronization
messageRegex: .*(Can't click element|Can't fill element|strict mode violation|element\(s\) not found|resolved to hidden|locator\.(waitFor|click|dblclick|fill|press|selectOption): Timeout|page\.(waitForSelector|goto): Timeout|expect\(locator\).*to(BeVisible|BeHidden|HaveText|ContainText|HaveValue|HaveCount).*failed|TimeoutError:|Timeout \d+ms exceeded while waiting).*

name: Assertion mismatch - requires triage
messageRegex: .*(Expected chart|Expected toast message|The message .* is not displayed|Text for element .* is not|expect\(received\)\.toBe).*
